quest.summary: My mother said a clearing hides in the tangle south of the ruins, by a dead tree. Find the way in.

offer: South of the ruins the trees grew into a knot. A gap in it, past the hall.
Mother said a clearing hides in it, by a dead tree. Mind the moss, she said.
The way runs past the ruins. After dark, keep wide of them.
done: So the moss still points the way. Take this idol. It was hers.
She kept it from the mist, she said. Now you keep it.
